title: Valet: restoring from your other devices
about: Valet's restore list (ADR-054, Suno_installer/valet_restore.py) against design-center daccee5 mockups/connect-sync/restore.html, drawn from tests/fixtures/valet-restore.json (GetRestore and ListDevices shapes). The launcher tile under the list is the Shell's and is removed from the reference. Viola's 'Ready · bookmarks and tabs here' is 'Ready' on the GTK side: Phase 1 doesn't sync the browser, and GetRestore has no per-app note. The reference page is placed where Valet's window puts it (its title row, left out on the GTK side, and the panel's 8 px inset: 73.4 px from the top, 42 px from the left), and its list given the 620 px it has in the design's own render (the conform page shrinks it to its words). A tile drawn as a picture (Kiln, Recipe Box) carries its glyph, so the reference's glyph inside .vlic is left out.

before.eval: (() => { if (matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches) document.documentElement.dataset.mode = 'light'; const s = document.querySelector('#stage'); const tile = s.querySelector('.cs-tile'); if (tile) tile.parentElement.remove(); s.style.boxSizing = 'border-box'; s.style.minHeight = '560px'; s.style.padding = '73.4px 42px 30px'; s.querySelector('.cs-rest').style.width = '620px'; for (const b of s.querySelectorAll('.cs-app small')) if (b.textContent.startsWith('Ready')) b.textContent = 'Ready'; })()
